name: io.github.hcarrillo001/retrieval-mcp
title: retriEVAL
description: LLM evals as MCP tools: score outputs for faithfulness, relevancy, and hallucination.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Judge model API key. Not needed if you set RETRIEVAL_JUDGE_BACKEND=ollama to run the judge locally.

environmentVariables.name: RETRIEVAL_JUDGE_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Which judge to score with: anthropic (default), openai, or ollama for a fully local judge.

environmentVariables.name: RETRIEVAL_JUDGE_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Judge model id, e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6 or qwen2.5:14b for Ollama.

environmentVariables.name: RETRIEVAL_BUDGET_USD
environmentVariables.description: Spend cap for judge calls. Unset means no cap.
